mapping_evidence: Exact official Jupiter roster surface on https://idolmaster-official.jp/live_event/azto/; corroborating title appearances in BNEI release https://www.bandainamcoent.co.jp/corporate/press/release/59/pdf/20140228.pdf lines 24-26; same names also appear under Jupiter in https://imas-sidem.com/character/.
